# LokTube 1.5.5

- Match YouTube's Shorts-shelf navigation on **Home** and **Watch History**: circular previous/next buttons overlay the leftmost and rightmost edges of the Shorts row, vertically centered over the content.
- Remove the two navigation arrows previously placed next to the Shorts History heading. The Show/Hide Shorts control remains in the header.
- Show edge arrows only when content can actually scroll in that direction; keep keyboard scrolling and add responsive updates as cards are added or the window is resized.
- Page by whole Shorts-card widths with smooth, reduced-motion-aware scrolling and hide the horizontal scrollbar for the same clean presentation.
- Use the same reusable shelf component on both screens, with regression coverage for arrow appearance and scrolling.
- Restrict Zen/Firefox link interception to **individual videos only** (watch URLs, Shorts, live video links). Leave YouTube Home, History, playlists, subscriptions, channels and search navigation in the browser. Restrict desktop protocol ingress consistently and add content-script interception tests.
